about.blurb: Jezero Crater held a lake 3.5 billion years ago. Perseverance has driven here since 2021, from the crater floor up the river delta to the rim, collecting rock samples for return to Earth.

base.name: Octavia E. Butler Landing
base.why: Perseverance's 2021 touchdown site: a proven safe landing (first end-of-drive stop in NASA/JPL's waypoint feed, sol 13)

dem_hirise.dataset: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation HiRISE DTM mosaic (Fergason et al., USGS 2020)

dem_hrsc.dataset: Mars HRSC + MOLA Blended DEM Global v2 (USGS)

ctx_ez.dataset: CTX image mosaic for Mars Human Exploration Zones: Jezero (USGS 2016)

viking_color.dataset: Viking MDIM 2.1 colour mosaic (NASA Ames recolour)

themis_night.dataset: THEMIS Night IR controlled mosaic v2 (USGS)

pois.name: Wildcat Ridge (delta front)
pois.why: Mudstone at the foot of the river delta, laid down as the lake dried. Its samples (sealed sols 509 and 516) hold organic molecules detected by the rover's SHERLOC instrument
pois.source: NASA/JPL M20 waypoint feed: rover stop at sol 502, the nearest to sol 509 (Hazeltop sample sealed, Wildcat Ridge)

pois.name: Three Forks Sample Depot
pois.why: The first sample depot on another planet: ten sealed tubes left on the ground (first dropped sol 653, Dec 2022) as a backup for Mars Sample Return. A crew could collect them on foot
pois.source: NASA/JPL M20 waypoint feed: rover stop at sol 652, the nearest to sol 653 (first tube dropped at the depot)

pois.name: Cheyava Falls (Neretva Vallis)
pois.why: The 'leopard spot' rock NASA calls a potential biosignature: the Sapphire Canyon sample, sealed sol 1215, is the strongest candidate for ancient microbial life found so far
pois.source: NASA/JPL M20 waypoint feed: rover stop at sol 1219, the nearest to sol 1215 (Sapphire Canyon sample sealed)

pois.name: Silver Mountain (crater rim)
pois.why: Perseverance's first sample from Jezero's rim (sealed sol 1401): ancient crust lifted up by the impact that made the crater, possibly among the oldest rock sampled on Mars
pois.source: NASA/JPL M20 waypoint feed: rover stop at sol 1400, the nearest to sol 1401 (Silver Mountain sample sealed, Shallow Bay)
